candidate.headline: Mark summaries stale after new replies
candidate.body: When a customer adds messages after a summary is generated, label that summary as stale until the assistant refreshes it.

failedCases.rationale: Summary freshness is directly relevant to the announced feature and is not represented in the baseline.
